notes.title: 🔥 Development Update: Leaderboards Are Coming! 🔥
notes.notes:
Survivors, get ready to test your skills against the world! 🌍🏆

We’re excited to confirm that Leaderboards will be part of The Daruma Challenge at launch! Whether you want to dominate the global rankings or compete against friends, this new feature will add replayability and challenge to every run.

🌟 What to Expect at Release?
✅ Global Leaderboard – See how you rank against players worldwide.
✅ Friends Leaderboard – Challenge your Steam friends directly.
✅ Personal Best Tracking – Keep pushing your limits!
✅ Real-Time Score Submission – Your best performances will be recorded automatically.

This will be a core feature on day one, so start preparing now… because only the best will survive.

👁️ Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to launch!
